SunnydeuS Caelestia live wallpaper sources

Origin: https://github.com/SunnydeuS/Caelestia-Live-Wallpapers-Integration
Revision: 3e2b9770e360c9159970b4ebbe6483cddd7529df
License: GNU GPL-3.0-only (see LICENSE)

This vendor copy contains only the Python, QML, and thumbnail sources used by
the Caelestia integration. Arch install, update, and uninstall scripts are not
included. The vendored sources are modified for this package to use one
Pictures/Wallpapers directory, content-aware media classification, cached
thumbnails, and shell-safe fallback behavior.
